title: docs(releases): 18.3.0 release notes and its upgrading row
body:

_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #29933

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：新增 18.3.0 发布说明页 `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx`，在 `meta.json` 里排在 `18-2` 之前；升级指南 `upgrading.mdx` 的 per-release 表加 v18.3.0 一行；`scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json` 登记新页（`check:docs-audit-scope` 要求）。纯文档，不发布任何包。
- **为什么改**：Version Packages #26517 已在 14:44Z 合并，npm 正在发布 18.3.0（`@objectstack/spec` 的 `latest` 在 15:15Z 变为 18.3.0），但发布页还不存在；维护者问「18.3 的版本发布文档开始写了吗」。
- **风险与回滚**：只动文档，回滚即 revert 本 PR。1,379 条条目用 GitHub Release 正文的同一个分组函数归类；需手动处理 / 自动迁移 / 新增能力 / 语义变化四段逐条列出，其他修复 760 条只按领域计数；升级清单是从 changeset 汇编的，没有实走。
- **先看**：① 页面的 Release facts，尤其「四个修复的代码已在 18.3.0 里、条目要等下个版本的 CHANGELOG」一条，其中 #29904 的修复是破坏性收紧（发布门拒收文本与数字比较的校验规则）；② Upgrade checklist 第 2 与第 4 步；③ `upgrading.mdx` 新增的那一行。
- **两分钟验证**：在本分支跑 `pnpm check:release-notes && pnpm check:doc-anchors`，预期两者都退出 0；或打开预览站 `/docs/releases/v18/18-3`，能看到五段和升级清单。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx`** (new, 1,115 lines), in `18-2.mdx`'s skeleton: Highlights; Release facts, as measured (with the 18.3.0 sweep); What's new under the five release-note headings; Console (Studio); Upgrade checklist.
  - Source: every `## 18.3.0` section the version commit `83d7e4ae33` (#26517) wrote, 110 CHANGELOGs, backend and `ui/`. Bullets deduplicated on their **full text**: 40,278 bullets, 37,836 of them `Updated dependencies`, leave 1,379 entries and one stray dependency line. First lines alone would collide: four entries open with the same `Shipped in 18.2.0` sentence and differ only by commit.
  - Placement: each entry through `classifyReleaseBullet` (`scripts/release-github-releases.mjs`), the function the GitHub Release body uses. Counts 264 / 41 / 307 / 7 / 760.
  - 需手动处理, 自动迁移 (with each ADR-0087 id), 新增能力 and 语义变化 are listed in full, each line the changeset's summary plus its commit and pull request. 其他修复 is counted by area. The area headings are a keyword reading of each summary, for navigation.
  - The upgrade checklist is marked **not walked**.
- **`content/docs/releases/v18/meta.json`**: `18-3` ahead of `18-2`.
- **`content/docs/upgrading.mdx`**: the `v18.3.0` row of Per-release specifics, in the form #26631 gave `v18.2.0`.
- **`scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json`**: one line, written by `node scripts/docs-audit/check-audit-scope.mjs --write`.

## Tests

Docs only: no package test applies. The page compiles as MDX (`@mdx-js/mdx` with `remark-gfm`, from the docs app's own dependencies), and so does `upgrading.mdx`. Every gate `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for the final diff was run locally on the final head; the readings are below and in the report comment on #29933.

## Acceptance notes

- **The four fixes with no 18.3.0 entry.** #29921, #29923 (BREAKING, for #29904), #29930 (for #29903) and #29932 merged after the version pull request was last refreshed. Their code is in `83d7e4ae33`'s tree (measured: `faultOutcome` in `packages/formula/src/validate.ts`, `withoutExtensionsOf` in `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`), and their changesets are still in `.changeset/`. The page says so and puts the #29923 refusal in the checklist.
- **The sweep.** The four run records (#29870, #29877, #29890, #29893) are all wave 5, at `589049b0`; three compare each item with its wave-4 record, and the export check has no wave-4 record. Of the eight p1s, four fixes ship with their entries, two ship as code only (above), and two ship nothing (a checklist edit, a test fix).
- **npm, read twice.** `@objectstack/spec` `latest` read `18.2.0` at 15:12Z and `18.3.0` at 15:21Z (`time["18.3.0"]` 15:15:07Z); `next` reads `18.2.0`. The page states both readings.
- **Wording.** Four summaries say "membership tier" for better-auth's word, so the page passes `check:role-word` (ADR-0090 D3).
- **Not run locally.** The docs site build (`Build Docs` in `ci.yml`) is CI's. The MDX compile above is the local stand-in.

## Verification

<details>
<summary>Measured counts and the commands that produced them</summary>

- CHANGELOG sections and entries: a scratch script over `git ls-files '*CHANGELOG.md'` at `83d7e4ae33`, using `getChangelogEntry`, `splitChangelogEntry`'s fence rule and `classifyReleaseBullet` from `scripts/release-github-releases.mjs`, deduplicating on full bullet text. 110 sections; 1,379 entries; 264 manual, 41 migrated, 307 added, 7 semantic, 760 other; 305 breaking (117 `minor`, 188 `patch`); 238 `minor`, 1,141 `patch`, 0 `major`; 544 touch an `@object-ui/*` package.
- Changesets: `git show --name-status 83d7e4ae33` lists 1,381 deleted `.changeset/*.md`; each mapped to its add commit with `git log --diff-filter=A`. 1,379 match an entry by commit; the other two (`ce9bc10`, `d3d70d3`) name only `@objectstack/example-showcase`.
- Packages: the workspace enumerator, version `18.3.0`: 109 public (73 `@objectstack/*`, `create-objectstack`, 35 `@object-ui/*`), 1 private (`@object-ui/app-shell`).
- p1 fixes: each closing pull request's merge commit, `git merge-base --is-ancestor SHA 83d7e4ae33` exit 0 for all eight.
- npm: `npm view @objectstack/spec dist-tags --json` at 15:12:31Z and 15:21:33Z.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Gates on the final head</summary>

Head `dce6df8264`, after one merge of `origin/main` (`21510bba61`). `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran ran.list`: **61 derived, 61 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN** (exit 0).

Two gates read built output and first refused on the build the merge left stale: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:docs` (exit 1, `json-schema` older than `src`) and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET). After `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/client-react...' --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build` under `os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0), both exit 0, as do `check:docs-transcript-drift` and the two `@objectstack/lint` doc gates, re-run on the same build.
